env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Check the installed plain driver, not the potentially experiment-built test binary.
exec $TESTGO_GOROOT/bin/go$GOEXE version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.[0-9]+(-X:[^ ]+)? [a-z0-9]+/[a-z0-9]+$'
# A toolchain built with GOEXPERIMENT reports a -X: stamp upstream-style.
[!expstamp] ! stdout '-X:'

go help
! stdout 'logos|loGo|Logos|LOGOS'
